_week: 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-22 (Week 47), MAC Energy US. Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales tripled to $254,391 (+203%) from $83,936. Thu–Sun brought $212,318 of it, with $64,288 on Thursday alone.
Every flavor grew: Proper Punch +457% to $48,503, Green Apple +359%, Orange Creamsicle +348%, Macberry Lychee +120%, Variety Pack +95% to $79,039.
refunds: Refunds were $1,704 (0.7% refund rate) on 13,542 orders, against $1,406 the week before. No action needed.
pacing_reco: November is $425,691 through Nov 22; at $19,350 a day it lands near $580,488, above October's $483,507. Ad spend is $309,348 month to date.
ads_context: Ad spend rose 114% to $181,661 and ad sales rose 131% to $115,622.
ACoS fell from 170.1% to 157.1% and TACoS from 101.3% to 71.4%, but each $1 of ads still returns only $0.64.
ads_strategy: Category keywords took $87,035 for $41,256 (211% ACoS), up from $34,928. Competitor targeting: $51,479 for $29,863 (172%).
Branded keywords returned $19,981 on $9,185 (46% ACoS). Auto was cut to $601 (was $2,611).
